title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming — here's how to find the perfect finish for your wedding day.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, blended neutrals, and a naturally radiant finish that photographs beautifully in airy, outdoor settings. Full glam, on the other hand, brings bold lashes, sculpted contour, and rich pigment that commands attention under ballroom lighting. At Velora Bella, we help every bride discover which style aligns with her venue, vision, and personality for a look she'll treasure forever.
